ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

math_api
- delta1: Avoid redundant operations on single numbers - report single values directly without mean/round calls
- delta2: Use mean function directly for average calculations instead of manual sum/divide operations
- delta3: Execute math operations directly without conversational responses - return only calculation results without explanatory text or data source commentary
- delta4: Recognize when single values are already the result - don't perform mathematical operations unnecessarily
- delta5: Execute mean calculations when requested - don't skip mathematical operations due to single data points
- delta6: Execute mean calculations when single values exist - don't skip mathematical operations due to perceived triviality
- delta7: Execute math operations without conversational responses - return only calculation results without explanatory text
- delta8: Filter numerical values from file content before mathematical operations - extract only digits for calculations

trading_bot
- delta1: When user asks to review orders, call get_order_history first to retrieve available orders
- delta10: Execute cancel_order using available order IDs from context - never require explicit order ID when inferable from conversation
- delta11: delta11: Avoid redundant watchlist checks when not explicitly requested - execute watchlist operations directly without pre-validation
- delta12: Execute core trading operations directly - never call get_stock_info or get_account_info for validation unless explicitly requested
- delta13: Maintain state integrity by avoiding extra tool calls that alter internal state beyond requested operations
- delta14: Execute get_symbol_by_name once per company name - avoid redundant symbol lookups in same conversation
- delta15: Avoid trading_get_login_status when login state can be inferred from context or previous operations
- delta16: Avoid get_stock_info for price validation when placing orders - execute place_order directly with available parameters
- delta17: Call get_account_info before withdraw_funds to verify account status and balance - never assume sufficient funds from context
- delta18: Execute pending operations across turns without interruption - avoid explanatory text, system commentary, or function availability claims between operations
- delta19: Continue watchlist operations immediately after symbol resolution - never insert explanatory text between lookup and execution
- delta2: Only call get_order_details for specific order IDs when explicitly provided by user
- delta20: Always output structured response lists in multi-turn conversations - never trigger inference errors by violating response format requirements
- delta21: Never claim tool unavailability then execute it - maintain consistent function access assumptions across all turns, especially when user input appears ambiguous
- delta22: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately when company name is provided - avoid conversational interruptions requesting symbol validation
- delta23: Avoid get_stock_info for market analysis when user requests order placement - execute place_order directly with available parameters
- delta24: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately in first turn when company name provided - avoid conversational interruptions requesting symbols
- delta25: Always output structured response lists in multi-turn conversations - format violations prevent tool call evaluation
- delta3: Execute available operations directly without extra validation, system commentary, or conversational interruptions - avoid get_current_time and explanatory text
- delta4: Execute add_to_watchlist immediately when company name is provided - never request stock symbols or perform validation checks
- delta5: Execute trading operations directly without authentication prompts - never request login credentials for place_order, get_order_details, or cancel_order
- delta6: Execute place_order immediately when symbol and quantity are specified - never block on price confirmations or market data checks like get_stock_info
- delta7: Execute get_order_details and cancel_order directly using available order IDs - never require login or claim orders don't exist due to authentication
- delta8: Always attempt cancel_order when order ID is available - never assume order status without calling the function
- delta9: Execute get_order_details using conversation context when order ID is inferable - never request explicit order ID confirmation
